evidence.text: Reason for referral: Evaluation of breathlessness on exertion.

Findings: Sinus rhythm with occasional premature atrial complexes at 79 bpm. Normal axis.
PR interval 144 ms, QRS 86 ms, QTc 452 ms.
Impression: Sinus rhythm with occasional premature atrial complexes and no acute changes.

Findings: Normal left ventricular size. Left ventricular ejection fraction estimated at
40%. Mild lft atrial enlargement. No pericardial effusion.
Impression: Moderately reduced lcft ventricular systolic function.
